craft_notes: Sthāyin: ant-crawl (the slowest word in the text — pipīlā kept). Rows: row 2 (bound→spreads). Close: spreads (prathate — unhurried verb matches the ant). Rejected: 'seconds' for velā — killed: time kept via ant-image; 'channels' alone — all-channels-bound kept.

lines: Channels all bound, up-breath power, slowly:
at the crawling ant's time — supreme happiness spreads.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvasrotonibandhena prāṇaśaktyordhvayā śanaiḥ | pipīlasparśavelāyām prathate paramaṃ sukham

reads_against.argmap: How does supreme happiness spread? → Slowly, bound channel by channel, supreme happiness spreads at the crawler's pace.
c1_essence: Bound channels, up-breath: happiness spreads at ant's pace.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta charged with vīra (wonder armed with intensity)
